Hydrogen ions are formed when glycolysis is a major means of resynthesising ATP, because anaerobic glycolysis produces lactate and H⁺, which accumulate and lower pH. This is the context the team note points to, and it's a different answer from my earlier one, which was about acids releasing H⁺ in water. The question has no options, so I can't confirm which sense is intended.
CONFIDENCE: 60
